narr: A warm and very moist air mass was in place across the region on July 10. Thunderstorms with heavy rainfall formed in the afternoon across the area with several instances of flash flooding.
ev: A picture from social media showed water over Shore Main Drive in Bloxom.
HRT Bus Operators reported that low-lying streets in Norfolk, Portsmouth, and northern Chesapeake were flooded.
Virginia Beach Boulevard flooded in Norfolk. Water was about one foot deep and covered the highway.
Delays were reported due to standing water on US-1 South in in the vicinity of Palmer Springs Road in Mecklenburg County near Bracey.
Roads were flooded east of Little Creek along Shore Drive. One foot of water was reported over the roadway.
Ferrell Parkway near Indian River Road was impassable due to standing water.
Flooding was reported along Independence Boulevard.
